scope: Bound codec-owned registration vectors that authorize selected TABLESTYLE, Background and SUN write references.

behavior: All four registration types share const-copy staging into a temporary vector and count validation before copying; their rvalue overloads validate before consuming caller storage.
Oversized input clears stale registration data and sets an independent rejection bit. A valid replacement clears only its own bit, so correcting one registration cannot hide another rejected list.
A pending rejection blocks a new write before output creation; an invalid registration attempted during an active write marks the attempt failed.
The added private rejection state requires downstream consumers to rebuild; ABI compatibility remains gated under P8.

normalFocused.coverage: All four registration setters reject oversized input and clear stale values; independent rejection state survives unrelated correction; valid replacements clear their own state; ASCII/Binary write refusal preserves an existing destination and accepts a corrected same-codec retry.

limitations: The 100,000-entry limit is an internal resource ceiling, not a DXF format maximum or support claim.
Allocation failure during a valid const-vector copy was not fault-injected in this slice.
These registrations authorize selected references; they do not establish target existence, correct target roles or semantic completeness by themselves.
Other unbounded setup inputs, including handle remaps, source BLOCK_RECORDs and canonical linetype metadata, remain in the P6 safety audit.
next: Continue the P6 safety and caller-state audit on remaining unbounded copied setup inputs and assembly paths.
